rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for an elite person or group, including top performers.

example.english: This elite team is representing Hong Kong in the competition.
example.traditional: 呢隊精英代表香港參加比賽。
example.jyutping: ni1 deoi6 zing1 jing1 doi6 biu2 hoeng1 gong2 caam1 gaa1 bei2 coi3

rows.note: Use this for the privileged upper class as a social stratum rather than for an individual top performer.

example.english: Their family belongs to the elite.
example.traditional: 佢哋一家屬於上流社會。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 suk6 jyu1 soeng6 lau4 se5 wui6

rows.note: Use this colloquial noun for someone highly skilled at a particular task or activity.

example.english: He is an elite player in this game.
example.traditional: 呢個遊戲入面，佢真係高手。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jau4 hei3 jap6 min6 keoi5 zan1 hai6 gou1 sau2
